name: Government Medical College, Kannur (Pariyaram)
tagline: Major government teaching hospital and referral centre for north Kerala
summary: Large government-run medical college and teaching hospital at Pariyaram serving as a referral centre for northern Kerala; offers MBBS, multiple PG seats and many specialty services.
description: Government Medical College, Kannur (commonly Pariyaram Medical College) is the state-run medical college and large teaching hospital serving northern Kerala. The campus combines undergraduate and postgraduate medical education with a multi‑speciality hospital.

The institution was established as a medical college at Pariyaram in the 1990s and later came under government management; it functions as a key referral and training centre for Kannur and neighbouring districts.
Visitors to the campus come for outpatient clinics, emergency care and specialist consultations; medical students and trainees use the college’s clinical wards, labs and teaching facilities.
Practical details such as bed capacity, departments and course intakes are published by the college and government sources — confirm specific services and schedules with the hospital before travel.
highlights: State-run medical college and teaching hospital serving north Kerala
Undergraduate MBBS (100 seats) and multiple postgraduate seats across specialties (see college intake).
Large multi‑speciality referral hospital (hospital declares several hundred beds to official registries; confirm current capacity).
Emergency and speciality departments supporting regional referrals and training
Campus commonly referred to as Pariyaram Medical College / Academy of Medical Sciences (former name)

sections.heading: Background
body: The college at Pariyaram began as a medical teaching institution in the 1990s and later became known as the Academy of Medical Sciences, Pariyaram. The Government of Kerala took over management under official ordinances and government orders and it now operates as Government Medical College, Kannur.

The institution combines medical education and a large teaching hospital that handles referrals from northern Kerala. Official college pages describe it as one of the major super‑speciality institutions in the region.

sections.heading: Services and training
body: The college runs an MBBS programme (100 seats) and a range of postgraduate and super‑speciality courses (MD/MS/DM entries appear on the college intake lists). Departments include core clinical specialties and super‑speciality services that support a regional referral load.

The attached teaching hospital provides inpatient and outpatient care, emergency services and diagnostic imaging; the college’s official filings list hospital bed numbers reported to regulators, and those figures have varied across government and national reports — check the college or hospital for the current bed capacity.

The campus also supports clinical training, simulation and other teaching activities for students and house‑officers; professional and academic activities from local medical associations and speciality groups are held on campus periodically.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: The hospital campus is at Pariyaram on the Payyanur–Kannur corridor (Pariyaram Medical College PO, Kannur 670503). For appointments, queries and confirmations use the college contact channels listed on the official site.

Travel: the nearest commercial airport is Kannur International Airport (Mattanur) and the nearest major railway station is Kannur; both are roughly 25–35 km away by road (distances vary by route). Local buses, taxis and private vehicles connect Pariyaram with Kannur and nearby towns.

If you are visiting as a patient or relative, carry ID, referral documents and previous medical records. For clinical or academic visits, confirm visiting hours, outpatient schedules and permission requirements with the college ahead of time.

latest.text: Monthly reports from local paediatric association list activities and CME events held at or with participation from Pariyaram (IAP Kannur branch activity reported June 2026).
The college appears in 2026 professional/seat listings and PG allotment summaries (shows participation in 2026 postgraduate admission rounds).

visitorInfo.bestTime: Open year-round; emergency care and inpatient services operate continuously. Confirm outpatient clinic days/hours before visiting.
visitorInfo.howToReach: Pariyaram Medical College PO (Pariyaram) on the Payyanur–Kannur corridor. Nearest airport: Kannur International Airport (Mattanur) ~25–35 km. Nearest major rail: Kannur Railway Station ~30–35 km. Local buses and taxis serve the campus; confirm route/time locally.
etiquette: Confirm clinic appointment times and which department will see you — outpatient schedules change.
If you travel for specialised treatment, bring referral letters, prior test reports and contact the hospital’s office in advance.
Parking and wait times can be long for busy specialty clinics; plan extra time and arrange local accommodation if needed.
